fusions.name: Rolling Stampede
fusions.desc: Rolls over and over through every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Unflagging Lunge
fusions.desc: A snapping strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Staying Power
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Wellspring
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
